title: Dam flooded the Egyptian labyrinth in the 1960s
summary: Joe Rogan tells of Dam flooded the Egyptian labyrinth in the 1960s, about 1960s; ancient at Egypt (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: What happened was they put up a dam and when they put up a dam to help the farmers out, they diverted the water and the water filled up this labyrinth.

plain: Podcast host Joe Rogan, speaking with Jesse Michels in 2025, retells a story he credits to a man named Ben Van Kerkwyk and to the ancient writers Herodotus and Pliny the Elder. They describe a vast ancient labyrinth, a maze of chambers in Egypt, and Rogan says that in the 1960s a dam was built to help farmers, and the diverted water filled the labyrinth. If true, it would mean an important ancient site now lies hidden under water.
